versionPairs.description: esbuild's PRODUCTION shape: a real esbuild 0.27.2 `--bundle --minify --format=iife --platform=node` build of the shared node-app source (test/e2e/fixtures/node-app) (24 local CJS deps + the real npm package ms@2.1.3, a CJS module requiring a lazy ES module, a dynamic import, a kept-external node:path, a deterministic stdout report). KNOWN GAP (plugin-spec I2): --minify shortens the helper names esbuild's detector reads, so detection says unknown and the passthrough adapter extracts nothing. v1.1.0 perturbs the last dep (adds tripled), the late module's output and the lazy stamp.
